verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is a SaaS document-parsing platform with SDKs and a CLI, so telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Self-hosting/BYOC and SOC 2 cover data residency and compliance, not opting out of telemetry, so they are not credited here.
